translations.b0482: Part 16  Developing Whole-Process People’s Democracy and Improving the Socialist Legal System with Chinese Characteristics
translations.b0483: China will unswervingly follow the path of socialist political development with Chinese characteristics, uphold the organic unity of Party leadership, the people running the country, and law-based governance, and consolidate and develop a lively, stable and united political situation.
translations.b0485: China will expand orderly political participation by the people, enrich democratic forms at all levels, and develop whole-process people’s democracy that is more extensive, fuller and more sound, ensuring that the people conduct democratic election, consultation, decision-making, management and oversight in accordance with the law. The system of people’s congresses will be upheld, improved and operated effectively; the system under which people’s congresses oversee administrative, supervisory, judicial and procuratorial organs will be improved, ensuring that state organs exercise power and perform their duties in accordance with the law and that the people’s democratic rights and legitimate interests are safeguarded and realized. The system of multiparty cooperation and political consultation under the leadership of the Communist Party of China will be upheld and improved; the CPPCC’s role as a specialized consultative body will be given full play; coordination among various consultation channels will be strengthened; and consultative democracy will be advanced to develop extensively, at multiple levels and in an institutionalized manner. Grassroots democracy will be improved; the people’s right to manage grassroots public affairs and public welfare undertakings in accordance with the law will be safeguarded; and the democratic management system for enterprises and public institutions, with workers’ congresses as the basic form, will be improved. Mechanisms for soliciting public opinion and pooling public wisdom will be improved. The role of people’s organizations such as trade unions, the Communist Youth League and the Women’s Federation will be better leveraged, and policy support will be strengthened for building the industrial workforce and for the development of young people, women and children. The all-round development of human rights will be promoted. The broad united front work pattern will be improved, and the broadest possible patriotic united front will be consolidated and developed. A strong sense of community for the Chinese nation will be forged, and the building of the Chinese national community will be advanced. The principle that religions in China must be Chinese in orientation will be upheld, and law-based governance of religious affairs will be strengthened. The Party’s policies on overseas Chinese affairs will be fully implemented, the hearts and strengths of overseas Chinese will be better rallied, and the role of bonds such as clan ties, hometown ties and ancestral culture will be brought into play.
translations.b0486: Chapter 58  Advancing Law-Based Governance in All Respects
translations.b0487: China will uphold law-based governance in all respects and make coordinated progress in scientific legislation, strict law enforcement, impartial administration of justice and observance of the law by all, so that the rule of law better plays its role in consolidating the foundations, stabilizing expectations and securing the long term and a socialist country under the rule of law is built to a higher standard. The implementation and oversight of the Constitution and laws will be strengthened, and the systems and mechanisms for safeguarding the uniformity of the country’s rule of law will be improved. Legislative planning and legislative review will be strengthened, channels and ways for the public to participate in legislation will be broadened, the quality of legislation will be improved, and the formulation and revision of laws and regulations in fields such as finance and tendering and bidding will be accelerated. The building of a law-based government will be stepped up, the recording and review of administrative normative documents will be fully implemented, and mechanisms for the substantive resolution of administrative disputes will be improved. Law enforcement will be intensified in key areas that bear on the immediate interests of the people, and cross-departmental coordination and oversight of law enforcement and the administration of justice will be strengthened. The exercise of judicial power will be regulated, mechanisms for realizing and evaluating judicial fairness will be improved, and the fairness, stability and authority of judicial rulings will be enhanced. Personal rights, property rights and personality rights will be protected in accordance with the law. Procuratorial oversight will be strengthened, and public interest litigation will be advanced. The national enforcement system will be improved, and the problem of difficulty in enforcing court judgments will be effectively resolved. The development of the foreign-related legal system and capacity will be accelerated, mechanisms for international commercial mediation, arbitration and litigation will be improved, and the International Organization for Mediation will be supported in playing a better role. Oversight and inspection of leading officials in handling matters in accordance with the law will be strengthened, and the working mechanism for comprehensive evaluation of law-based governance will be improved. The building of a law-based society will be further advanced; the ranks of lawyers and other legal service providers will be expanded at a faster pace; inclusive public legal services will be improved; publicity and education on the rule of law will be strengthened; and a sound environment will be fostered in which the whole of society respects the rule of law, abides by rules, honors contracts and upholds justice.
